title.en: A conversation changes with its setting
title.zh: 交谈方式会随场合变化

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构的宁在第1、6题都选5，计分为5与3，均值4；乔都选4，均值也4。宁可能想到发言积极却私下安静，乔的两个中点却没有提供同样参照；页面不能验证这些原因，也不把任一模式改成“矛盾型”。即使某人该均值比其宜人性低，跨维原始数顺序仍不是社会能力排名或需要增加聚会的证据。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: Fictional Ning selects five on items 1 and 6, giving keyed values five and three and a mean of four; Jo selects four twice, also averaging four. Ning might consider speaking actively yet being quiet privately, while Jo’s two midpoints supply no such reference. The page verifies neither explanation and assigns no contradictory type. Even a mean below one’s Agreeableness is no social-ability ranking or evidence that more gatherings are needed.

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“怎样让同一均值下不同的原回答与参与场合同时可见，而不要求任何人变得更外向？”可以只用上述虚构人物与数字，一人解释公式，另一人指出相同均值仍未知什么。允许不同理解、不回答或结束，不要求交换个人测评、关系或健康资料，也不要求参与者为分数改变行为。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “How can different original responses and participation settings remain visible beneath an equal mean without requiring anyone to become more outgoing?” Use only the fictional people and numbers above: one explains the formula and another identifies what equal means leave unknown. Different interpretations, declining or stopping are allowed without exchanging private assessments, relationships or health information, or requiring anyone to change behavior for a score.

title.en: A brief instrument, with a declared edition

paragraphs.zh: 本版保留TIPI英文原十组特质和七级赞同选项，中文为费马独立工作译文；每题按两个形容词整体评价，不拆作二十题。选项1至7，4为既不同意也不赞同，非缺答、四成或人群平均；无“不适用”与跳过项，不愿回答可退出清除，不需虚填。十题均有效才显示全部五维，任一缺答均不生成个人均值，不补零、不补中点。第2、4、6、8、10题计分为8减原回答；外向性1与6R、宜人性2R与7、尽责性3与8R、情绪稳定性4R与9、经验开放性5与10R，两项各取均值1至7、步长0.5，两位小数不增加精度。第9题不反向，方向不改叫神经质；每题原回答、计分值和公式可见。五维不合总分、不相减、不选主导、不派类型或面向，不以均值次序评价人格、职业或关系；相同均值的不同回答组合不被自动判无效。通用完整指南无需作答，个人完成后五篇都保留；它们不声称网页核实了原因或他人评价。作者为极短测量选择宽领域覆盖，并不以高alpha或漂亮因子拟合为唯一设计目标；这不等于两题没有误差、适合细面向或每次结果都可靠。原量表研究和公开许可不建立此网页、中译或语言等值的验证，不使用其研究样本常模给此处用户派百分位。没有诊断、健康证明、录用、兼容性或有意义变化阈值；重做差异也不能单独证明学习、改善或永久特质改变。本站编辑新增例子与讨论不属于原始量表，也不代表作者背书。可只谈虚构人物、保留分歧或停止，无须披露个人分数、困难、身份或真实他人资料。默认不保存；另行选择的当前标签页草稿24小时失效，完成、清除或重测删除草稿，未选择草稿时离开或刷新不保留回答。分享只复制公开测试标题与入口，无个人回答、均值或答卷标识；可选匿名动作计数沿现有许可与全站分析同意控制，不含回答或均值。删除草稿不清除浏览器历史、截屏或旁人看屏。
paragraphs.en: This edition retains the original ten English TIPI trait pairs and seven agreement anchors alongside an independent FermatMind working Chinese translation. Rate each adjective pair overall; it is not twenty separate questions. Responses run from one to seven; four is neither agree nor disagree, not missing, forty percent or a population average. There is no not-applicable or skip option; exit and clear rather than inventing an unwanted response. All ten valid responses are required for any personal means. Missing responses yield no personal domains and are not replaced by zero or a midpoint. Items 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 use eight minus the original response. Average 1/6R for Extraversion, 2R/7 for Agreeableness, 3/8R for Conscientiousness, 4R/9 for Emotional Stability and 5/10R for Openness. Each mean spans one to seven in half-point steps; two decimals add no precision. Item 9 stays direct and the direction is not renamed Neuroticism. Original responses, keyed values and formulas remain visible. The five domains are not combined, subtracted, assigned a dominant type or expanded into facets. Their order evaluates no personality worth, occupation or relationship; different response combinations with equal means are not automatically invalid. General full guides are readable before answering and all five remain after completion, without verifying causes or other people’s views. The author designed for broad coverage under extreme brevity rather than high alpha or clean factor fit alone. This does not eliminate error, measure narrow facets or guarantee every individual result. Research and public permission for the instrument do not validate this website, working Chinese or language equivalence; research-sample norms assign no percentile here. There is no diagnosis, proof of health, hiring verdict, compatibility or meaningful-change threshold. Repeat differences alone establish no learning, recovery or permanent trait change. Added scenes and discussions are website editorial content, not original scale content or author endorsement. Discuss only fictional people, retain disagreement or stop without disclosing personal scores, difficulties, identities or real third-party details. Nothing is saved by default. A separately chosen tab-only draft expires after 24 hours and is removed on completion, clearing or retaking. Without that option, leaving or refreshing retains no responses. Sharing copies only the public test title and entry, without ratings, means or an attempt identifier. Optional anonymous activity counts follow existing page permission and site analytics consent and contain no responses or means. Removing a draft erases no browser history, screenshots or screen observation.

title.en: An example involving a shared deadline

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构的沐第2题选5、第7题选6，计分3与6，均值4.5；思第2题选3、第7题选4，计分5与4，也4.5。前者较认同争辩与温暖两对，后者的温暖题为中点；相同均值并不核实两人如何对待别人。讨论共同期限时，可以分别说明边界与体谅，不能凭这两个数判定谁更善良、谁应让步或谁欠更多照顾。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: Fictional Mu selects five on item 2 and six on item 7, giving keyed values three and six and a mean of 4.5. Si selects three and four, giving five and four and the same 4.5. Mu endorses both critical and warm descriptions more; Si chooses the midpoint for warmth. Equal means verify no treatment of others. Discussing a shared deadline can separate boundaries from consideration without deciding who is kinder, must concede or owes more care from two ratings.

title.en: A question about one real exchange
title.zh: 关于一次真实交流的问题

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“怎样区分体谅、必要分歧与顺从，并避免用评分替别人安排关系义务？”可以只用上述虚构人物与数字，一人解释公式，另一人指出相同均值仍未知什么。允许不同理解、不回答或结束，不要求交换个人测评、关系或健康资料，也不要求参与者为分数改变行为。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “How can consideration, necessary disagreement and compliance be distinguished without assigning someone relationship obligations from ratings?” Use only the fictional people and numbers above: one explains the formula and another identifies what equal means leave unknown. Different interpretations, declining or stopping are allowed without exchanging private assessments, relationships or health information, or requiring anyone to change behavior for a score.

title.en: A reminder system changes the context

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构的羽第3题选6、第8题选5，计分6与3，均值4.5；安分别选4与3，计分4与5，同样4.5。原回答不同，不能凭均值判断谁用了提醒、谁更努力或哪种困难的原因。若两题都选4，是两次“既不同意也不赞同”，不是中度赞同。可以谈一个虚构约定所需的提醒与资源，不需拿实际工作记录证明可靠，也不把工具帮助扣成人格缺陷。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: Fictional Yu selects six on item 3 and five on item 8, giving keyed values six and three and a mean of 4.5. An selects four and three, giving four and five and the same 4.5. Different responses identify no use of reminders, effort or cause of difficulty. Selecting four twice means neither agree nor disagree twice, not moderate agreement. Discuss reminders and resources for a fictional commitment without requiring work records to prove dependability or treating useful tools as a character defect.

title.en: Try an observation rather than a score target

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“怎样保留原回答与资源条件，不把中点误读为赞同，也不把均值当作效率或努力的证据？”可以只用上述虚构人物与数字，一人解释公式，另一人指出相同均值仍未知什么。允许不同理解、不回答或结束，不要求交换个人测评、关系或健康资料，也不要求参与者为分数改变行为。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “How can original responses and resources remain visible without reading a midpoint as agreement or a mean as evidence of productivity or effort?” Use only the fictional people and numbers above: one explains the formula and another identifies what equal means leave unknown. Different interpretations, declining or stopping are allowed without exchanging private assessments, relationships or health information, or requiring anyone to change behavior for a score.

title.en: A difficult week is not a permanent label
title.zh: 困难一周不是永久标签

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构的悦第4题选6、第9题选6，计分2与6，均值4；橙都选4，也4。悦可能想到不同情境里的烦乱与沉着，网页并不知道；橙两次中点也不是无情绪。反向的是第4题，不是第9题，得到的方向仍叫情绪稳定性。任何一项均值都不能决定人物是否痛苦、该不该获得支持或是否应隐藏情绪；另一维度的高分也不与它抵消。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: Fictional Yue selects six on items 4 and 9, giving keyed values two and six and a mean of four; Cheng selects four twice, also averaging four. Yue might have different settings in mind for upset and calmness, but the page cannot know. Cheng’s midpoints do not mean an absence of emotion. Item 4 is reversed, not item 9, and the direction remains Emotional Stability. Neither mean decides distress, access to support or a duty to hide feelings; another domain’s larger value cancels nothing.

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“怎样讨论形容词的情境参照，同时不由均值推断健康、恢复或承受困难的义务？”可以只用上述虚构人物与数字，一人解释公式，另一人指出相同均值仍未知什么。允许不同理解、不回答或结束，不要求交换个人测评、关系或健康资料，也不要求参与者为分数改变行为。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “How can the settings behind adjectives be discussed without inferring health, recovery or a duty to endure difficulty from a mean?” Use only the fictional people and numbers above: one explains the formula and another identifies what equal means leave unknown. Different interpretations, declining or stopping are allowed without exchanging private assessments, relationships or health information, or requiring anyone to change behavior for a score.

paragraphs.zh: 本版保留TIPI英文原十组特质和七级赞同选项，中文为费马独立工作译文；每题按两个形容词整体评价，不拆作二十题。选项1至7，4为既不同意也不赞同，非缺答、四成或人群平均；无“不适用”与跳过项，不愿回答可退出清除，不需虚填。十题均有效才显示全部五维，任一缺答均不生成个人均值，不补零、不补中点。第2、4、6、8、10题计分为8减原回答；外向性1与6R、宜人性2R与7、尽责性3与8R、情绪稳定性4R与9、经验开放性5与10R，两项各取均值1至7、步长0.5，两位小数不增加精度。第9题不反向，方向不改叫神经质；每题原回答、计分值和公式可见。五维不合总分、不相减、不选主导、不派类型或面向，不以均值次序评价人格、职业或关系；相同均值的不同回答组合不被自动判无效。通用完整指南无需作答，个人完成后五篇都保留；它们不声称网页核实了原因或他人评价。作者为极短测量选择宽领域覆盖，并不以高alpha或漂亮因子拟合为唯一设计目标；这不等于两题没有误差、适合细面向或每次结果都可靠。原量表研究和公开许可不建立此网页、中译或语言等值的验证，不使用其研究样本常模给此处用户派百分位。没有诊断、健康证明、录用、兼容性或有意义变化阈值；重做差异也不能单独证明学习、改善或永久特质改变。本站编辑新增例子与讨论不属于原始量表，也不代表作者背书。可只谈虚构人物、保留分歧或停止，无须披露个人分数、困难、身份或真实他人资料。默认不保存；另行选择的当前标签页草稿24小时失效，完成、清除或重测删除草稿，未选择草稿时离开或刷新不保留回答。分享只复制公开测试标题与入口，无个人回答、均值或答卷标识；可选匿名动作计数沿现有许可与全站分析同意控制，不含回答或均值。删除草稿不清除浏览器历史、截屏或旁人看屏。
paragraphs.en: This edition retains the original ten English TIPI trait pairs and seven agreement anchors alongside an independent FermatMind working Chinese translation. Rate each adjective pair overall; it is not twenty separate questions. Responses run from one to seven; four is neither agree nor disagree, not missing, forty percent or a population average. There is no not-applicable or skip option; exit and clear rather than inventing an unwanted response. All ten valid responses are required for any personal means. Missing responses yield no personal domains and are not replaced by zero or a midpoint. Items 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 use eight minus the original response. Average 1/6R for Extraversion, 2R/7 for Agreeableness, 3/8R for Conscientiousness, 4R/9 for Emotional Stability and 5/10R for Openness. Each mean spans one to seven in half-point steps; two decimals add no precision. Item 9 stays direct and the direction is not renamed Neuroticism. Original responses, keyed values and formulas remain visible. The five domains are not combined, subtracted, assigned a dominant type or expanded into facets. Their order evaluates no personality worth, occupation or relationship; different response combinations with equal means are not automatically invalid. General full guides are readable before answering and all five remain after completion, without verifying causes or other people’s views. The author designed for broad coverage under extreme brevity rather than high alpha or clean factor fit alone. This does not eliminate error, measure narrow facets or guarantee every individual result. Research and public permission for the instrument do not validate this website, working Chinese or language equivalence; research-sample norms assign no percentile here. There is no diagnosis, proof of health, hiring verdict, compatibility or meaningful-change threshold. Repeat differences alone establish no learning, recovery or permanent trait change. Added scenes and discussions are website editorial content, not original scale content or author endorsement. Discuss only fictional people, retain disagreement or stop without disclosing personal scores, difficulties, identities or real third-party details. Nothing is saved by default. A separately chosen tab-only draft expires after 24 hours and is removed on completion, clearing or retaking. Without that option, leaving or refreshing retains no responses. Sharing copies only the public test title and entry, without ratings, means or an attempt identifier. Optional anonymous activity counts follow existing page permission and site analytics consent and contain no responses or means. Removing a draft erases no browser history, screenshots or screen observation.

title.en: One interest does not represent every domain
title.zh: 一项兴趣不能代表全部领域

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构的宁第5题选7、第10题选4，计分7与4，均值5.5；沐选6与3，计分6与5，同样5.5。前者一个强赞同与一个中点，后者两项计分略接近；两题仍不能区分艺术想象、求知或其他面向。人物也可能喜欢陌生音乐并采用熟悉食谱，这不构成类型冲突；机会、时间或资源没有被这两题量化。无需购买新体验、披露爱好或改变生活方式证明开放。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: Fictional Ning selects seven on item 5 and four on item 10, giving keyed values seven and four and a mean of 5.5. Mu selects six and three, giving six and five and the same 5.5. One strong agreement plus a midpoint differs from two closer keyed values, yet neither pair separates artistic imagination, curiosity or other facets. Enjoying unfamiliar music while using familiar recipes creates no conflicting type. Opportunity, time and resources are not quantified here. No purchase, hobby disclosure or lifestyle change is needed to prove openness.

title.zh: 可以跟随好奇，不必追逐新奇

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“怎样澄清新体验与熟悉常规的具体例子，而不把资源、消费或某种兴趣当作开放性的标准？”可以只用上述虚构人物与数字，一人解释公式，另一人指出相同均值仍未知什么。允许不同理解、不回答或结束，不要求交换个人测评、关系或健康资料，也不要求参与者为分数改变行为。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “How can examples of new experiences and familiar routines be clarified without using resources, spending or a particular interest as a standard of openness?” Use only the fictional people and numbers above: one explains the formula and another identifies what equal means leave unknown. Different interpretations, declining or stopping are allowed without exchanging private assessments, relationships or health information, or requiring anyone to change behavior for a score.
